jamie: Quick all-hands async — drop 1-line highlight + 1 ask if you have one. I'll start.

jamie: Highlight: v2 routing canary ran overnight, p50 latency ~12% down. Seeing a few 503s for long-tail regional pods, tracing open.
jamie: Ask: need an owner to reproduce the dedupe-cache eviction flake in staging. @sahil can you take? :eyes:

sahil: On it. digging into KV cache TTL mismatch. `kv_cache.eviction() logs` show inconsistent timestamps. Will push a small patch by noon PT.

sahil: Quick FYI — pushed a smoke test to staging, kicking off now.

leah: Yesterday: shipped rollout dashboard frontend PR, backend metrics wired. Ask: can product sanity-check new error KPI thresholds? @morgan?

morgan: I can review after standup. Also: dedicated infra maintenance Fri 01:00-03:00 UTC — expect degraded throughput for reserved pools. Please schedule critical jobs outside that window.

zoe: Experiment note: int8 quantization cut GPU mem ~30% but increased p95 by ~0.8ms on short prompts. Not sure it's rollout-ready without more AB tests.

jamie: Good notes. small ops asks: 1) add a one-line release note in #eng-releases when you roll model variants, 2) if you need warmup tokens for canary, ping me with expected QPS and seq_len.

ops-bot: Reminder: on-call rotation swaps today at 09:00 PT — @jamie assigned for the first shift.

leah: Created bug #342 in the linear-pipeline board with repro steps and logs.

sahil: Patch passed smoke, running e2e now. Will update by 11:30 PT.

morgan: Product looked at thresholds, ok to start as warn-only for 24h, then escalate.

jamie: Perfect, thanks everyone. If no more asks, I'll close thread after noon PT with a 2-line summary. :thumbsup:
